name: MonarchTheme
title: Theme
summary: Applies a Monarch theme: colors, typography, shapes, spacing, elevation and motion, and a Material 3 theme derived from them.
whenToUse: Once, around the content of every activity. Nest another MonarchTheme with fixed tokens to pin a theme for part of a screen.
whenNotToUse: Not to change one color of one component; pass the color to the component instead.
api: @Composable fun MonarchTheme(scheme: MonarchScheme = MonarchScheme.System, contrast: MonarchContrast = MonarchContrast.System, accent: MonarchAccent = MonarchThemeDefaults.Accent, typography: MonarchTypography = MonarchTypography.Default, dynamicColor: Boolean = false, reducedMotion: Boolean? = null, ai: MonarchAccent? = null, content: @Composable () -> Unit)

@Composable fun MonarchTheme(tokens: MonarchThemeTokens, typography: MonarchTypography = MonarchTypography.Default, dynamicColor: Boolean = false, reducedMotion: Boolean? = null, content: @Composable () -> Unit)
object MonarchTheme { colors, typography, shapes, spacing, elevation, motion, isDark, isHighContrast, focusRingWidth }
fun resolveMonarchTheme(scheme: MonarchScheme, contrast: MonarchContrast, accent: MonarchAccent, systemInDarkTheme: Boolean, systemInHighContrast: Boolean): MonarchThemeTokens

options.name: accent
options.description: One of the 21 accents in MonarchTokens.Accents.

options.name: typography
options.description: The type roles; monarchTypography(fontFamily = ...) for a product typeface.

options.name: dynamicColor
options.description: On Android 12 and later, gives plain Material 3 components the wallpaper colors. Monarch components keep Monarch colors.

options.name: tokens
options.description: Second overload: one fixed theme, without reading the system settings.

options.name: ai
options.description: A product color for AI content, applied after the accent with withAi; null keeps the theme's AI colors. Also on the brand overload.

options.name: reducedMotion
options.description: Overrides the system Remove animations setting for the subtree; null follows the system.

states.name: hc-light
states.description: The high-contrast light theme, with a wider focus ring.

states.name: hc-dark
states.description: The high-contrast dark theme, with a wider focus ring.

appearance: Four themes with 96 color roles each. The accent replaces the accent roles and the link color; in the standard themes also the focus ring. A custom AI color (withAi, from MonarchBrandTheme.aiAccent) replaces the AI roles, thinking and citation.
platformNotes: The web sets data attributes on a root element and iOS puts a value in the SwiftUI environment. Android wraps MaterialTheme, so plain Material 3 components are themed too. Material primary and error map to the strong accent and danger roles, because Material uses them as text as well as fills. System contrast exists from Android 14; medium and high both select the high-contrast themes.
accessibility: Follows the system dark theme setting unless a scheme is given.
Follows the system contrast setting on Android 14 and later.
Sets the minimum interactive size of Material 3 components to 48dp.
Reports the Remove animations setting as MonarchTheme.motion.reducedMotion.
edgeCases: A component used outside MonarchTheme falls back to the light theme.
Below Android 14 the system contrast is always standard.
